Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Nordgren
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 21 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment which, if ratified, would authorize the Legislature to call itself into a special session. This constitutional amendment will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Further, this constitutional amendment could increase the obligations of the Legislature by an estimated $360,000 for each special session called by the Legislature.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
